title: polyglot-cred-union-stream-ux-v2
author: Maya Patel
description: Introduce a compact, forward-compatible 'CredentialUnion' across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs and stabilize streaming ergonomics (pull/push parity, clearer session lifecycles). This PR standardizes SDK credential shapes so platform code can accept a single union type, adds two retry presets for auth-sensitive transient errors, fixes a TypeScript overload regression that caused ambiguous stream typing in consumer code, and bumps SDKs to new minor releases. Motivation: many integrations were duplicating auth unwrap logic and special-casing streaming session handoffs; a shared union + small ergonomic adapters reduces boilerplate and surface inconsistency across languages. Implementation highlights: add CredentialUnion type and small shims in each SDK, unify stream close/abort semantics, provide explicit `resumeToken` hints for pullstreams, add retry profiles (auth_fast, auth_safe) in SDK-level retry catalog, and bump python->0.38.0, typescript->1.12.0, go->0.9.2. CI: multi-language gate, initial flaky integration test in TS fixed by narrowing overload and adding guard, e2e across a minimal hosted/dedicated matrix. Backwards compatibility: new union accepts previous credential shapes; adapters log a deprecation warning when legacy fields are used. Related Linear work: ENG-2234, ENG-2419.
commits: feat: add CredentialUnion type and adapter shims (py/ts/go)
fix(ts): resolve ambiguous stream overload causing consumer type errors
perf(py): lazy-evaluate auth token lookups in stream warmup path
test: add cross-sdk e2e scenario for auth-failover + resume token
review_comments: Ethan Cole: Left a minor comment on TS overloads; suggested narrowing union discriminant.  Author: resolved by switching to explicit 'kind' tag and adjusting generics.
Lina Gomez: Asked for clearer deprecation messaging for legacy token fields; added a single-line logger and entry in migration docs.
Arjun Mehta: Asked for benchmarks on stream warmup latency; added micro-benchmark and noted <3ms median impact in comment thread.
release_notes: Introduce CredentialUnion across SDKs (py 0.38.0, ts 1.12.0, go 0.9.2). Stabilize pull/push stream ergonomics, add resumeToken hints, add auth retry presets (auth_fast, auth_safe). Backward compatible; minor deprecation warnings for legacy credential fields. See docs/sdk-migration/credential-union.md for migration steps.
notes: This PR intentionally kept adapter layers small so downstream SDK consumers can opt-in. We plan a follow-up to provide higher-level credential orchestration helpers in a separate feature flag.
